name: Sikafloor-94
paste:
SIKAFLOOR®-94: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikafloor®-94, April 2023, Version 01.06 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sikafloor_-94.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikafloor®-94 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.06).
1.2 Product description. Sikafloor®-94 is a two component, low viscosity, 100% Solid Epoxy Primer and Binder resin system
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikafloor®-94 may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Primer for concrete surfaces with Sikafloor resin systems.
    - Binder resin for Epoxy mortar Sub-fill mortar screeds.
    - Binder for epoxy Coving mixes.
    - Flow and scratch coat layering prior to Sikafloor systems.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikafloor®-94
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Low viscosity, solvent free epoxy Primer and general purpose Binder resin
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Potable Water certified to AS 4020 - 2014
    - VOC compliance to Aust. Green Building Codes V1.1- 13.1.1 and V1.1-12.1.1B
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS 4020: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Low viscosity
    - Excellent substrate penetration
    - Very low odour - VOC
    - Excellent binder for mortars
    - Fast to cure
    - Can be accelerated with Sikafloor Booster
    - Economical
    - Good Chemical Resistance
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Yellowish transparent
    - Density: 1.1kg / litre
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compressive strength: > 40 MPa
    - Tensile strength in flexure: 22 MPa
    - Tensile adhesion strength: 12 MPa approx - (to sandblasted steel)
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in proportioned 30 kg, 60 litres and Bulk 200 kg Parts A+B
    - Shelf life: Stored in original sealed containers within the temperature range of +5 to +35 degress C, this product will keep for 3 years from date of manufactre.
    - Storage conditions: Stored in a dry place and out of direct sunlight within temperatures as mentioned above.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.06) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.06) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Part A Part B = 2 :1 (by Mass and Volume)
    - Consumption: Primer; CSP 2-3 profile 5-6m2 L approx. CSP 4-5 profile 2-3m2 L approx. Mortar; Range of 1:5 to 1:8 mixed litre of Sikafloor®-94 to kg blended silica sands
    - Pot Life: 10 Degrees C - 30 mins. 20 Degrees C - 20 mins.
    - Waiting time to overcoating: 10 degrees C 15 hours; 20 degrees C 8 hours; Note: Waiting times are approximately halved with the addition of Sikafloor Booster

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Application range recommended +5 to +30 Degrees C
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikafloor®-94, April 2023, Version 01.06, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sikafloor_-94.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 94 Part A, version 10/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/SDS%20Sikafloor%20-%2094%20Part%20A%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikafloor 94 Part B, version 10/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/SDS%20Sikafloor%20-%2094%20Part%20B%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikafloor®-94 Part A, version 24/05/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/sds-sikafloor-94parta.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaFloor: Resin Flooring Solutions, version 08/11/2023, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/Sikafloor%20Resin%20BROCHURE%202023%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical product, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Mixing. Part A and B to be mixed the correct ratio for a minimum of 2 minutes
6.4 Ecology, health and safety - Application.
    - Primer
    - Roll product evenly on and into the surface.
    - If the product is completely absorbed then an additional coat should be applied within 24 hours. Mortar
    - When used as a binder in Profiling screeds or Coving mixes, the substrate should also be primed with Sikafloor®-94
6.5 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.6 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.7 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
